limitations: Legacy SSE MCP transport is rejected; streamable HTTP only.
MCP OAuth sign-in opens a browser; headless/SSH requires pasting the redirect URL.
Tokens are stored by Pi in ~/.pi/agent/mcp-auth.json, never in this package or its evidence.
Shell-level `pi mcp` commands do not load extensions; the extension registration is session-scoped and a file-configured `htp` entry takes precedence.

distribution.rollback: record the installed full commit before upgrading (pi list prints the checkout path; git -C <checkout-path> rev-parse HEAD). Global: pi remove git:github.com/hatchertechnology/htp-pi, then `pi install git:github.com/hatchertechnology/htp-pi@0a386f04b03087ab4c16834e64bdd5c362ec6618` (full Wave 1 package: extension, five skills, 25 canonical operations). Project-local (--local): list with pi list --approve; pi update is not project-scoped (it reconciles every scope that has the source), so roll back only the project with pi remove git:github.com/hatchertechnology/htp-pi --local --approve then pi install git:github.com/hatchertechnology/htp-pi@<full-40-hex-sha> --local --approve. A full commit is immutable; a tag also works when it resolves; earlier commits may lack Wave 1 resources.

provenance.note: Installed-runtime docs for the tested Pi build are authoritative; declared repository docs may be private.

readiness.htp: extension registers the htp MCP server and reports connection/auth state; live HTP OAuth sign-in requires the user's browser and is a release verification step
readiness.seosmith: local operations adapter implemented and exercised through the Pi runtime with a controlled fixture, and verified end-to-end against a locally built SEOsmith origin/main binary (bounded example.com crawl, partial coverage reported truthfully). No build artifact is committed.

gates: HTP Business Profile writes require the HTP feature flag.
Durable provider requests (contract 1.1.0) require deployed backend support and tool schema verification.

Additive parity reads 1.4.0 (website_audit_lifecycle, website_url_lifecycle, website_remediation_list) stay gated by tool discovery and the HTP_ROLLOUT_LIFECYCLE / HTP_ROLLOUT_REMEDIATION flags; an unavailable (503) read is held, never an empty page.

Search evidence and independent-audit comparison reads are web-dashboard and REST-only; no MCP tool exists, so a tools/list absence is unsupported and these reads are never fetched outside the web dashboard.
Direct SEOsmith private-worker HTTP access requires explicit operator configuration.
SEOsmith staging profiles (S13) and baseline CI (S16) have not shipped.
Live HTP OAuth sign-in and a live crawl with a real SEOsmith build are release verification steps, not satisfied by fixture tests alone.
